Washington Feb 6 1864
Geo Sheldon Ft Monroe 
I want the most stringent
care exercised on your part
that nothing in the way
of information or indications regarding
present zebras of audits youth
passes over the wires open
put every thing into wriggle
T. T. Eckert


Ft. Monroe Feb 6 . 1864 
John Horner New York
for A B Davenport four garden street
or twenty four court street Brook Lynn
period John H Lester formerly of brook
Lynn whom you used to insure and
who left for Negus Early in the
war has been caught on his return
north & is held here as a
blockade runner period It is necessary for
me to establish certain facts period The
Commanding vernon requests that you furnish me
immediately by supper with the dates from
your register when his policies of insurance
ran out Inform me also for
how long they were continued in
the name of P R Wetmore
